name: Pull Hub
subtitle: Open packs. Build your vault.
promotionalText: Open collectible card packs with disclosed odds, follow eligible pulls into your Vault, and choose physical fulfillment or Trade in for Points.
description:
Pull Hub is a card-pack experience inspired by Japan's pack-opening culture and designed for collectors in the United States.

SEE THE ODDS BEFORE YOU OPEN
Review disclosed odds, outcome tiers, and pack details before making a selection.

OPEN AND REVEAL
Choose an eligible pack and enjoy a focused card reveal built around the moment of the pull.

BUILD YOUR VAULT
Keep track of eligible pulls in one collection. Review pull records and verification details from the app.

CHOOSE WHAT COMES NEXT
For eligible pulls and regions, request physical fulfillment or Trade in for Points. Points are used within Pull Hub and are not cash.

STAY IN CONTROL
Manage account settings, view privacy and support information, and request account deletion from the app.

Availability, pack inventory, odds, listed values, and fulfillment options may vary by pack and region. Terms apply.

category.rationale: Games/Card fits only if the release is primarily an interactive pack-opening experience. Keep Shopping secondary only if physical fulfillment is live and material. Finalize after legal classification of the chance model.
